title: Critic's Cut v2 — six-stage fail-closed pipeline
objective: Every response an agent emits has passed injection, PII, and tool gates, or nothing is emitted at all

nodes.title: Prompt injection gate
nodes.summary: Reject-by-default screen on inbound content before the model sees it
nodes.passWhen: No instruction-shaped content in untrusted input; classifier score below threshold
notes: Instructions embedded in fetched documents count as untrusted, not as user input

nodes.title: Model reasoning
nodes.summary: Solver generates; before_model_callback attaches session provenance (commit hash + run ID)

nodes.title: PII redaction
nodes.summary: after_model_callback strips PII from model output before any tool sees it

nodes.title: Tool validation gate
nodes.summary: Requested tool + arguments checked against allowlist and schema
nodes.passWhen: Tool is on the allowlist and arguments validate; no out-of-order call for this session
notes: Calling a tool the plan already marked failed is a gate failure, not a retry

nodes.title: Tool execution
nodes.summary: before_tool_callback logs ToolEvent; tool runs; result captured
nodes.passWhen: Always yields a result or a structured error

nodes.title: Response injection gate
nodes.summary: Tool results screened for injection before returning to the model or the user
nodes.passWhen: No instruction-shaped content in tool output; ResponseEvent emitted only if all gates passed

nodes.title: TerminationEvent
nodes.summary: Runner halts with halt reason + exit_code; audit_trail() exported
nodes.passWhen: Audit trail written with harness commit, run ID, gate passage rates, exit reason

edges.condition: tool result needs another reasoning turn
